- The arrows of the inheritance tree are

a.title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.

a.title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. a.title: • DataFingerprint: Hash value (digital fingerprint) of the logical or physical representation of data.
a.xlink:title: • DataFingerprint: Hash value (digital fingerprint) of the logical or physical representation of data.

a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.
a.xlink:title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • ObjectName: A standard means of expressing a name for a class object. A linguistic signifier. Human understandable name (word, phrase, or mnemonic) that reflects the ISO/IEC 11179-5 naming principles.

a.title: • conformsTo: An established standard to which the described resource conforms. (See DCMI Metadata Terms - https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#conformsTo)
a.xlink:title: • conformsTo: An established standard to which the described resource conforms. (See DCMI Metadata Terms - https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dcmi-terms/#conformsTo)

a.title: • DataSet: Organized collection of data based on keys.
a.xlink:title: • DataSet: Organized collection of data based on keys.

a.title: • LogicalRecord: Collection of instance variables.
a.xlink:title: • LogicalRecord: Collection of instance variables.

a.title: • PhysicalMapping: Physical characteristics of the values of an instance variable as part of a physical data set.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalMapping: Physical characteristics of the values of an instance variable as part of a physical data set.

a.title: • Concept: Unit of thought differentiated by characteristics (from the Generic Statistical Information Model version 1.2: https://statswiki.unece.org/display/clickablegsim/Concept).
a.xlink:title: • Concept: Unit of thought differentiated by characteristics (from the Generic Statistical Information Model version 1.2: https://statswiki.unece.org/display/clickablegsim/Concept).

a.title: • SegmentPosition: Assigns a position to the segment within the whole physical data set. For example in what order does this 80 character segment fall within an 800 character record.
a.xlink:title: • SegmentPosition: Assigns a position to the segment within the whole physical data set. For example in what order does this 80 character segment fall within an 800 character record.

a.title: • PhysicalMappingPosition: Denotes the position of a physical mapping in a sequence within a physical data set.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalMappingPosition: Denotes the position of a physical mapping in a sequence within a physical data set.

a.title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.
a.xlink:title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.

a.title: • Segment: Description of each storage segment required to completely cover a physical data set.
a.xlink:title: • Segment: Description of each storage segment required to completely cover a physical data set.

a.title: • List: Simple ordered Collection defined as a list of Members where the location of each Member in the list is given by the associated Position class.
a.xlink:title: • List: Simple ordered Collection defined as a list of Members where the location of each Member in the list is given by the associated Position class.

a.title: • StructuredDataSet: Information describing the physical aspects of a data set using a binary or highly structured text-based encoding.
a.xlink:title: • StructuredDataSet: Information describing the physical aspects of a data set using a binary or highly structured text-based encoding.

a.title: • TabularTextDataSet: Information describing the physical aspects of a data set which is encoded using a text-based method and which has an essentially tabular structure.
a.xlink:title: • TabularTextDataSet: Information describing the physical aspects of a data set which is encoded using a text-based method and which has an essentially tabular structure.
